# Add unit tests for critical services

Description

Add unit tests for core backend services (InventoryService, PriceService, Catalog/Listing services) to reduce regressions and increase confidence.

Acceptance criteria

- Unit tests added for at least InventoryService and PriceService.
- Tests run with `cd backend && npm run test` and pass locally.
- Coverage report added or CI job updated to run tests.

Source: BACKLOG.md — "Pruebas unitarias base para servicios críticos (parcial)".
